title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 10: the visit of the queen of Sheba, Solomon's gold, his ivory throne and his horses from Egypt.

questions.text: Why did the queen of Sheba come to Solomon?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:1 says that when the queen of Sheba heard of Solomon's fame, she came to test him with hard questions.

answers.text: To test him with hard questions
To ask for help in a war

questions.text: What did the camels of the queen's caravan carry?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:2 says she came with camels that bore spices, very much gold, and precious stones.

questions.text: What did the queen of Sheba say about the report she had heard?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 10:7 she says she did not believe the words until she saw it herself, and that not even half was told her.

answers.text: Not even half was told me
It was only about his riches

questions.text: According to the queen, why had Yahweh made Solomon king?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 10:9 she says that because Yahweh loved Israel forever, he made Solomon king to do justice and righteousness.

questions.text: What did the king make from the almug trees brought from Ophir?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:11-12 says the king made pillars for Yahweh's house and the king's house, and harps and stringed instruments for the singers, from the almug trees.

answers.text: Ships for the fleet of Tarshish
The steps of his ivory throne
Doors and beams for the palace

questions.text: What was the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:14 says the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold.

questions.text: What was Solomon's great throne made of?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:18 says the king made a great throne of ivory and overlaid it with the finest gold.

answers.text: Ivory overlaid with the finest gold

questions.text: What stood on the six steps of the throne, on the one side and on the other?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:20 says twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps.

questions.text: Why were none of the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon made of silver?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:21 says none were of silver, because silver was considered of little value in the days of Solomon.

answers.text: Silver was forbidden by the law
Silver was considered of little value
All the silver was sent to Hiram
There was no silver left in the land

questions.text: From where were Solomon's horses brought out?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:28 says the horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt.
